paragraphs: Moose Movie is a bilingual (Vietnamese / English) movie and TV browsing app built on TMDB data. It is a portfolio rebuild of an older Create React App project with Next.js 16. Pages are server-rendered or statically generated for SEO and fast first paint. Client JavaScript is limited to interactive leaf components. Every change goes through lint, type checks, unit and component tests, Playwright E2E tests and Lighthouse budgets in CI.
features: Home: trending hero slider with trailers, plus six carousels (popular,
top rated and upcoming movies; popular, top rated and on-the-air TV).
Lists: movie and TV lists with "Load more" pagination through Server
Search: search across movies, TV and people. Vietnamese diacritics and
special characters survive the round trip through the URL.
